each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']; h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for row in gi for c in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nb=[(i,j,gi[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    print('==',k,'bg',bg)
    ch=[(i,j,go[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if gi[i][j]==bg and go[i][j]==1]
    for cell in sorted(set(ch)):
        m=min(abs(cell[0]-n)+abs(cell[1]-m2) for n,m2,_ in nb)
        print('  ',cell,'->1  manhToNb=',m)
    print('  unchanged bg cells near:')
    for cell in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if gi[i][j]==bg and go[i][j]!=1][:15]:
        m=min(abs(cell[0]-n)+abs(cell[1]-m2) for n,m2,_ in nb)
        print('   ',cell,'manh=',m, 'out=',go[cell[0]][cell[1]])

from collections import Counter
def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); cnt=Counter(c for row in g for c in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
